theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) modified with Swiss Brutalism

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Chunky, solid, generous padding, un-apologetically heavy

button.base: border-4 border-black bg-primary text-white font-black uppercase transition-all duration-75

input.base: border-4 border-black bg-white p-4 font-bold focus:outline-none focus:ring-0 focus:shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(224,77,54,1)]

tab_bar.base: fixed bottom-0 w-full border-t-4 border-black bg-surface flex justify-around p-4 z-50
tab_bar.item: flex flex-col items-center justify-center font-bold uppercase text-xs gap-1

difficulty_pill.base: border-2 border-black font-bold uppercase px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]

HOME.description: Dashboard view. Contains Time Wallet, Locked App Cards, Daily Challenges.
HOME.time_wallet: Hero card at the top. Massive text showing minutes. 'Add Time' button opens games.
HOME.locked_apps: List of apps with lock icons. Include +/- brutalist buttons to allocate time from wallet.

GAME.start_screen: Hero graphic, 'Prove you're focused. Score at least 60%...', Difficulty selector, Start button.
GAME.win_screen: 'Challenge Passed!' Title, Score card, playful quote, Play Again/Back buttons.
GAME.loss_screen: 'Don't quit, almost there!', Try Again/Back buttons.

MANAGE_APPS.app_list: Toggle list (lock/unlock) with switch components that have thick borders.

SETTINGS.features: Change password, reset, mock premium paywall ('Go Pro' with yellow accent).

hero_background.description: Terracotta abstract minimal background for the premium section.

game_puzzle.description: Rubik's cube representation for brain games category.

locked_overlay.description: Chained smartphone representation for the App Locked Overlay screen.

testing_rules.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, inputs, and interactive cards. Use kebab-case.
